The '''Field House''' was, along with the [[Hearth House]], one of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen's]] two legislative bodies. The Field House's members served one-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-long terms and were chosen at random from a list of residents who had received a brief [[Politics/Legends|political]] education, a measure that allowed the working class to have a say in government.<ref name="Strongholds" />

The Field House was responsible for choosing the members of the Hearth House, who would serve for life and had been more extensively trained for political life. Although the Hearth House produced most of Kinyen's laws, the Field House had the right to veto any law that it had passed. The latter met in a section of [[Doellin's Ring]], the center of Kinyen's planetary government, which was also known as the [[Field House (location)|Field House]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Field House was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
